learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to measure the outside borders of shapes and figure out exactly how much space is hidden inside them!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Imagine walking all the way around the edge of a park. The total distance you walked is the perimeter! To find it, you just add up the lengths of all the outside sides.
While perimeter is the fence, area is the grass inside! Area tells us how much flat space a shape takes up. We usually measure it by counting how many tiny squares can fit inside the shape.

fun_activity.title: 🧵 The Thread Measurement Mission
fun_activity.instructions: Take a piece of thread and wrap it exactly once around your favorite book. Cut the thread and measure it with a ruler. Congratulations, you just found the perimeter of your book!

quick_recap: ⭐ Perimeter is the total distance around the outside edge of a closed shape.
⭐ Area is the amount of 2D space inside the boundary of a shape.
⭐ You can find the perimeter of a rectangle by adding the length and width, then doubling it!
